fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a code page switch in command line or batch scripts to a rare language
fields.name: Suspicious CodePage Switch Via CHCP
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\chcp.com" and (tgt.process.cmdline contains " 936" or tgt.process.cmdline contains " 1258")))
